title: Spatial Contract v1 -- Experiment Telemetry Record
$comment: Stage D1 frozen contract, version-stamped and renamed from scripts/drawn_response/schemas/method_run_log.schema.json (structurally unchanged; the draft's own $comment already frames it as harness scaffolding for latency/cost/reviewer-burden metrics -- exactly the Phase D prompt's 'experiment telemetry' bullet). One method invocation may produce several criterion_decision_result rows; this is the per-invocation log distinct from those per-criterion records.

criterion_decision_ids_produced.description: criterion_decision_result IDs (see criterion_decision_result.v1.schema.json) this single invocation produced. Renamed from the draft's criterion_ids_produced to avoid ambiguity with criterion_id (the item-authored criterion instance) -- this field lists decision record IDs, not criterion IDs.
